name: office_artifact
description: Assess, create, edit, verify, publish, discard, or restore DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX artifacts through Nexa's transactional OfficeArtifactEngine. Prefer this over manually composing run_shell document pipelines. execute creates a validated candidate by default; decide publishes or discards that candidate; restore uses a receipt and refuses to overwrite newer work.

action.description: Lifecycle action. Use assess before guarantees that require optional native/render backends.

workspace_root.description: Registered local source directory that contains every source, destination, spec, manifest, candidate, and receipt path.

request.description: OfficeArtifact requestVersion 2 payload for assess or execute.

candidate_id.description: Candidate id returned by execute; required for decide.

receipt_id.description: Publication receipt id; required for restore.
